briefing.headline: OpenAI unveils Orion-2 as xAI and DeepSeek close capability gap in frontier race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with multiple model releases this month. Compute constraints and regulatory scrutiny intensify amid escalating global competition. DialectForge gains traction in enterprise security evaluations.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 achieving 92% on GPQA. Anthropic's Claude 4.1 and Google's Gemini 3.0 Pro launched within days. DeepSeek-R2 and xAI Grok-3 demonstrate competitive reasoning benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra clusters shipping to Microsoft and Google. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving with new Saudi data center builds underway.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU slow frontier model releases enough to allow Chinese labs to overtake by 2027?
